style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 4 and up: soft digital gouache with a gentle hand-painted texture, clean rounded shapes, thick-and-thin dark-brown outlines, warm friendly palette (mossy greens, honey yellows, soft browns, a touch of sky blue and berry pink), simple big eyes with a small highlight, rosy cheeks, calm smiling expressions, no sharp teeth or claws, no scary elements, no text, no watermarks.
styleSheet: A style sheet on a plain white background: a red fox, a small hedgehog, a brown owl and a red spotted mushroom standing side by side as friendly sticker characters, all facing slightly to the left, plus a small swatch of forest scenery (a tree trunk, ferns and grass) in the bottom corner. Consistent style, palette and line weight across everything.

stickers.prompt: A small round red mushroom with white spots and a cream stem, shy and sweet, cap tilted a little down like a hat, tiny friendly eyes peeking out, two small rosy cheeks.
stickers.faceNote: Its face is on the cream stem under the red cap: the stem stays cream and the cap stays as it is.

stickers.prompt: A young orange fox with a big fluffy white-tipped tail, bouncy and cheerful, mid-bounce with front paws up, bright happy grin, full body.
A small light-brown rabbit with long upright ears and a round white tail, eager and bouncy, sitting up on its hind legs about to hop, big excited eyes.
A small round fluffy yellow duckling with soft downy feathers, tiny stubby wings, a flat orange beak, orange webbed feet, big bright curious eyes, standing and mid-waddle, cheerful.
stickers.faceNote: The face is on fluffy yellow down with a flat orange duck's beak: the beak stays orange and duck-shaped (no lips, no teeth), the down stays yellow.

stickers.prompt: A tall sunny yellow flower with big round petals and a green stem with two leaves, a proud happy face in the centre, standing straight.
stickers.faceNote: Its face is on the round BROWN speckled seed centre of the flower: that disc stays brown and speckled, only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change; the petals stay yellow.

stickers.prompt: A dreamy butterfly with big rounded orange-and-gold wings with one blue spot on each, seen from the front with wings open, tiny smiling face, curly antennae.
A small round hedgehog with soft brown spines, a cream belly and face, a little worried-but-kind expression, small paws, standing on all fours.
stickers.faceNote: Show the feeling with the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks only: no paws, hands or anything else come up to the face.

stickers.prompt: A round tawny owl with big wise half-closed eyes, feathery ear tufts, wings folded, perched on a short branch, calm and sleepy.

prop.remove: the short branch with its leaves under the owl
prop.note: The owl stands on its own: its yellow feet drawn whole with the toes spread as if on the ground.

stickers.prompt: A slow calm snail with a swirly golden-brown shell, a pale green body, two eye stalks with a gentle contented eye at the tip of each, a tiny smile, sliding forward. The eyes on the stalks are its only eyes: no eyes on its face, which has just rosy cheeks and the smile.
A quick busy red squirrel with a huge bushy tail curled over its back, holding a hazelnut with both paws, alert bright eyes.
A tall gentle fawn with white spots, long careful legs, big soft brown eyes and large ears, standing calmly, kind expression.
A small round blue bird with a rosy chest, tiny wings, a short orange beak open in song, standing on a twig, cheerful.
stickers.faceNote: It has two eyes and both always show the expression together: the near one on its cream face, and the far one up by the top of its beak, against the blue of its head near the outline. When the eyes close (sleeping, happy), both close.

prop.remove: the twig with its leaves under the bird
prop.note: The bird stands on its own two thin orange legs with its toes spread as if on the ground; the tip of its blue tail is drawn whole.

stickers.prompt: A plump bright-green frog with big round eyes on top of its head, a wide happy grin, sitting on a lily pad, ready to jump.

prop.remove: the lily pad under the frog
prop.note: The frog sits on its own: its bent back legs and its webbed front and back feet rest flat as if on the ground.

stickers.prompt: A chubby fuzzy honeybee with soft yellow-and-brown stripes, small translucent wings, friendly eyes and a little smile, hovering.
A tiny red ladybug with seven black spots, small black head with kind eyes, standing on a green leaf, brave and cute.
stickers.faceNote: Its face is the round cream-coloured face on the front of its dark head: the face stays cream, only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change.

prop.remove: the green leaf under the ladybug
prop.note: The ladybug's six little dark legs are drawn whole, standing as if on the ground.

stickers.prompt: A small smiling acorn with a textured brown cap and a smooth tan body, tiny stubby arms out wide, giggling expression.
stickers.faceNote: Its face is on the tan acorn nut below the scaly cap: the nut keeps its colour and the cap stays as it is.

stickers.prompt: A curious raccoon with a black eye mask, ringed tail and clever little paws held up in front, cheeky friendly face, standing upright.
A tiny grey-brown mouse with big round pink ears, a long thin tail, bright brave eyes, whiskers, standing on hind legs looking up.
A friendly brown pinecone with layered rounded scales, a small gentle face near the top, lying at a slight angle as if ready to roll.
stickers.faceNote: Its face peeks out between the brown pinecone scales: the scales and the face's tan colour stay the same, only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change.

stickers.prompt: A small round brown bear cub with a cream muzzle and tummy, tiny rounded ears, sitting on its bottom with short arms resting on its belly, a sleepy content smile and half-closed eyes, soft and huggable, facing slightly left.

A stocky friendly badger with a white face and two bold black stripes over the eyes, a shaggy grey body and short dark legs, standing on all fours with its nose down sniffing the ground, kind curious eyes, facing slightly left.
stickers.faceNote: Keep the long snout, the black nose at its tip and the black-and-white stripes exactly where they are; only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change.

stickers.prompt: A chubby brown beaver with a broad flat scaly tail resting on the ground behind it, two big friendly front teeth, small round ears, sitting up and holding a short stick with both paws like a proud little builder, facing slightly left.

A small woodpecker with a bright red cap, black-and-white spotted wings and a cream chest, clinging upright to a short piece of tree trunk with its tail braced against the bark, beak pointed at the wood ready to tap, bright cheerful eyes, facing slightly left.
stickers.faceNote: Keep the long grey beak closed and exactly as it is; show the feeling with the eye, brow and cheek only.

prop.remove: the piece of tree trunk with its twig and moss that the woodpecker clings to
prop.note: The woodpecker keeps its pose, as if still clinging to an upright trunk: its feet drawn whole with the toes curled, its long grey beak drawn whole pointing left, its tail whole.

stickers.prompt: A small plump green caterpillar with round segments, tiny stubby legs, two short antennae and big friendly eyes, its front raised up as it walks along a big green leaf, cheerful, facing slightly left.

prop.remove: the big green leaf under the caterpillar
prop.note: The caterpillar's whole round green body and all its little brown legs are drawn whole, resting as if on the ground.

stickers.prompt: A small friendly firefly with a dark rounded body, big kind eyes, small translucent wings folded on its back and a softly glowing warm yellow tail light, perched on a curved blade of grass, facing slightly left.
stickers.faceNote: Its face keeps exactly the same warm brown as the rest of its head: do not lighten or darken it.

prop.remove: the curved blade of grass under the firefly
prop.note: The firefly's legs and its softly glowing tail are drawn whole, standing as if on the ground.

expressions.prompt: happy — a big, warm, open smile, the eyes smiling (curved upward, crinkled with joy), cheeks lifted and rosy.
a little sad — eyebrows tilted up in the middle, eyes soft and a bit droopy, a small downturned mouth. Gentle, not crying, no tears.
fast asleep — both eyes peacefully closed as soft curved lines, a small relaxed mouth, calm and cosy.
delighted surprise — eyes wide open and round, eyebrows raised high, a small round open "o" mouth. Amazed and happy, never scared.

scene.background: A bright forest clearing in soft daylight, seen from a child's height: soft grassy ground in the lower third, a gentle line of distant trees and ferns in the middle, a warm pale-blue sky with a few round clouds above (no sun in the sky); open space in the centre where stickers will be placed.
scene.foreground: The nearest elements only: two large tree trunks with a little foliage at the left and right edges, a few tall ferns and grass tufts along the very bottom. The whole centre and the sky stay empty and transparent.

edits.prompt: A small, calm forest pond lying flat in the meadow grass, seen from a child's height so it is a wide, flattened oval: clear blue-green water reflecting a little of the sky, three or four round green lily pads (one with a small white flower), a few soft reeds and cattails at its back edge and a thin rim of darker grass and pebbles around it. Gentle and inviting, no frogs or animals.

sky.description: the open sky between the two big trees, above the far forest

meadow.description: the open grass of the meadow, in front of the far bushes

pond.description: the small pond with lily pads and a water lily, right of the middle of the meadow

branches.description: the side branches of the two big trees at the edges, high up under the leaves

trunks.description: the trunks of the two big trees at the left and right edges

notes.stickers: Every character faces slightly left, whole body visible. Edit prompts freely; a changed prompt re-renders only that sticker.
notes.expressions: Each sticker with a `face` box (fractions of its raw art) gets one variant per expression: the face is repainted with a mask and only that area is laid over the raw, so the variant has exactly the sticker's outline and the app can swap it in place. The sticker itself is the 'normal' face.
